Read upstream technical sources. Relevant architectural alternative: full-system emulation of matching older iOS rather than rewriting MobileSafariUI. eShard describes iOS 14 GUI/touch/network/application research with substantial system modifications and hardware/Metal/version limitations; not reproduced here and no Android port established. QEMU-iOS provides legacy iPod Touch GUI precedent. darwin-vm explicitly lacks GUI. touchHLE excludes 64-bit iOS; unidbg is experimental execution support, not a proven browser GUI; Darling/iPasim are not drop-in Android solutions. Windows Safari 5.1.7 plus Winlator is an untested, outdated, different-platform candidate; old Apple installer URL returned 404, nothing downloaded/run. WPE and remote Apple-hosted execution remain distinct deliverables. No Apple images, protection-bypass patches, new services or APK were obtained, executed or published. Source-based findings and next validation gates recorded in experiment README.
